title: Record
text: View and log data to the workspace, a file, or both, 1 input, no direct feedthrough, {Row Group Policy Value} sets Height or; {Number of input ports}, {Decimation}, {Limit data points to last} sets the number of samples, {Select port} sets the port for which to specify input processing, {Input processing}, {Record to workspace} sets the workspace logging, {Workspace variable name} sets the name for workspace variable that contains logged block data, {Record to file} sets the log to file, {File name} sets the name of file with logged data, {File type} sets the type of file for logged, {File location} sets the path to file with logged data working, {Time}, {Signal Attributes} sets the signal attributes to export to Excel file Data, {Compression Type} sets the compression options Fastest, {Generate Sidecar} sets the option to generate JSON sidecar and {Row Group Policy} sets the options for grouping rows in Parquet file Row Group. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Signal to record scalar | vector | matrix | array | bus

params.name: Number of input ports
params.values: Number of input ports 1 (default) | integer in the range [ 1,100 ]

params.name: Limit data points to last
params.values: Number of samples to log inf (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Select port
params.values: Port for which to specify input processing mode 1 (default) | integer

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Input processing mode for selected port Elements as channels (sample-based) (default) | Columns as channels (frame-based)

params.name: Workspace variable name
params.values: Name for workspace variable that contains logged block data recordout (default) | character vector | string

params.name: Record to file
params.values: Log to file option off (default) | on

params.name: File name
params.values: Name of file with logged data recording.mldatx (default) | character vector | string

params.name: File type
params.values: Type of file for logged data *.mldatx (default) | *.mat | *.xslx | *.parquet

params.name: File location
params.values: Path to file with logged data working directory (default) | character vector | string

params.name: Time
params.values: Options for exporting time data to Excel or Parquet file Shared Time Columns (default) | Individual Time Columns

params.name: Signal Attributes
params.values: Signal attributes to export to Excel file Data Type | Units | Port Index | Block Path | Interpolation

params.name: Compression Type
params.values: Compression options Fastest (snappy) (default) | Balanced for Size and Speed (gzip) | Compact (brotli) | None (uncompressed)

params.name: Generate Sidecar
params.values: Option to generate JSON sidecar on (default) | off

params.name: Row Group Policy
params.values: Options for grouping rows in Parquet file Row Group Height (default) | Row Group Size (MB)

params.name: Row Group Policy Value
params.values: Height or size of row group auto (default when Row Group Policy is Row Group Height ) | 512 (default when Row Group Policy is Row Group Size (MB) | number of rows | size of row group
